name: SectionHeader
description: The heading of a section inside a page, for a card or a table: a title, a description and actions on the right.

title.description: The section's title, shown as an h2 by default.

headingLevel.description: Heading level of the title, 2 to 6.

actions.description: Buttons or a menu for the right of the title.

size.description: compact for pages with little room, such as a side panel or a dense admin screen.

divider.description: Draw a line under the header.

classNames.description: Extra class names for single parts, so you can restyle one part without editing the file. Keys: root, title, description, actions.

requirements: The title is a real heading below the page's h1, so the page has a clear outline
Actions wrap under the title on a narrow screen

use_when: Above a card, a table or a form section inside a page
avoid_when: The top of a page: use PageHeader
anti_patterns: Skipping heading levels (an h4 straight under the h1)

contract.data: A title, and an optional description and actions.
